visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text column (eyebrow, H2, body, accent rule) beside a large rounded photo
visualCharacteristics.description: Text column (eyebrow, H2, body, accent rule) beside a large rounded portrait-ish photo (~608x540), image vertically centered against text. Differs from columns-intro, which is a text-only section head (H2 left, short note right) with no media.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 eyebrow paragraph, H2, body paragraph; cell 2 image
contentPattern.description: Fixed pair of different content side by side (text column and a large photo) that never wraps: Columns.

usage.description: Destination intro ("A storied ribbon of shoreline...") on the destinations template.

reuseGuidance: Use when a section pairs a text column (optional eyebrow, heading, body) with one large photo side by side. Either cell order works; the image-only cell becomes the media column. For text-only section heads use columns-intro.

cells: Cell 1 content (columns-intro: eyebrow + H2; columns-media: eyebrow, H2, body; columns-panel: H3 + paragraph)
Cell 2 content (columns-intro: intro paragraph; columns-media: image; columns-panel: H3 + paragraph)
